description: Look up a published proof by its ID on Intentrax's public verifier (verify.intentrax.com) and return the verifier's status and per-dimension assessment. Read-only. The hosted assessment covers the record integrity and signer checks done by Intentrax's service; it is not a check against keys pinned on the caller's side. A proof records an Intentrax decision; it does not show that an external effect happened.

proof_id.description: Published Intentrax proof identifier (usually a 64-character hex string).

name: intentrax_verify_public_proof
title: Verify a published Intentrax proof
